stem.text: In which situation is the least amount of energy transferred?

A.text: A student and a motorcycle of total mass $80\,\text{kg}$ come to rest from a speed of $2.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.

B.text: A student of mass $50\,\text{kg}$ falls a vertical distance of $2.0\,\text{m}$.

C.text: A student pushes a car with a horizontal force of $70\,\text{N}$ for a horizontal distance of $2.0\,\text{m}$.

D.text: A student switches on a $70\,\text{W}$ lamp for $20\,\text{s}$.
